query: Which mixed-methods design (convergent, explanatory-sequential, embedded) will best link process-traced shock narratives and governance dynamics to latent RC indicators and why?

response.query: Which mixed-methods design (convergent, explanatory-sequential, embedded) will best link process-traced shock narratives and governance dynamics to latent RC indicators and why?
response.answer: The explanatory-sequential mixed-methods design best links shock narratives and governance dynamics to latent RC indicators by first collecting quantitative data, then using qualitative insights to explain quantitative findings.
